plugins.name: agent-kevin
plugins.description: Portable, file-based personal AI assistant. Compiles raw sessions into a queryable wiki, manages tasks across project lifecycles, drives SEO/web tools (Google Search Console, PageSpeed, SerpAPI, OpenPageRank, Playwright, Perplexity), and ships 18 skills covering onboarding, daily/weekly/monthly cadences, SEO audits, and content workflows. Runs entirely on local markdown + YAML. Your data lives wherever you launch Claude Code.
